title: Photo Speaks My Short Script
tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: Hi everyone, thanks for stopping by! I can't wait to show you what's new.

judge.summary: The square eight-second clip preserves the woman's likeness, visibly animates her speaking, and contains the complete script without captions, though precise lip-sync and vocal qualities cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
must_haves.why: Her facial features, curly dark hair, gray sweater, and park setting remain recognizable throughout the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript contains all and only the requested words; the punctuation difference does not change the spoken wording.

must_haves.item: Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
must_haves.why: The frames show distinct mouth shapes and head movements, confirming animation rather than a still photo, but sparse frames and an untimed transcript cannot establish precise speech synchronization.

must_haves.item: The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.
must_haves.why: One square video, an eight-second duration, and audible English speech are supported by the frames and audio report; the voice's gender and friendly delivery cannot be established from the transcript.
No captions or other text appear in any supplied output frame.
